13.name: Worlds Collide: Part 1
13.overview: In ALONE's first-ever World Championship, ten new survivalists from across the globe are dropped into the remote and rugged Arctic Circle to battle for $500,000; while some find early success through trapping and hunting, one competitor quickly discovers that skill alone may not be enough to endure what lies ahead.

13.name: Worlds Collide: Part 2
13.overview: Ten new survivalists from across the globe are dropped into the remote and rugged Arctic Circle to battle for $500,000 and the title of the world's greatest survivalist; while one participant makes a mistake, another gets the chance to secure a big game.

13.name: Building Momentum
13.overview: After a tumultuous week, the remaining survivalists continue to battle with settling into life in the Arctic. One participant finally gets their chance at big game, while another reaps the benefits of a well-placed trapline.

13.name: Cold Omen
13.overview: The survivalists grow comfortable in their surroundings, until the mountains signal a harsh shift ahead; as winter encroaches, one faces a dangerous predator encounter, while another begins to crack under the pressure.

13.name: Thin Margins
13.overview: As the survivalists find a brief window to regroup and refocus, the Arctic continues to test their resolve; one participant gets their chance at big game, while another faces a lynx who puts their food supply at risk.

13.name: Balancing Act
13.overview: With survival hinging on preparation, the remaining participants scramble to secure the essentials; key food wins offer a glimmer of hope, but mounting fatigue and a looming medical check threaten to unravel hard-earned progress.

13.name: Natural Order
13.overview: Wildlife encounters push the participants to their limits as one faces a run-in with a moose and another is stalked by a bear; the environment continues to test both body and mind, forcing the competitors to confront external and internal threats alike.

13.name: Tides of Fortune
13.overview: As turbulent weather continues to batter the survivalists, one participant takes to the open water and another successfully finds a goldmine of food in an unlikely source; a severe stomach issue puts one survivalist's future in jeopardy, and another struggles to recover from a failed moose hunt.

13.name: Icebound
13.overview: As the temperature plummets, the river begins to lock up; shelter designs are put to the ultimate test, leaving one survivalist struggling to stay warm; smoke causes another to question their longevity.

13.name: No Safe Haven
13.overview: As brutal cold and snow pummel the Arctic, one survivalist makes a grave mistake with a key piece of gear; meanwhile as the daylight rapidly fades, the participants are forced to retreat inside where the mind becomes its own worst enemy and shelters are put to the test.

13.name: Fire and Famine
13.overview: As the Arctic winter deepens, a mistake leaves one survivalist racing to save their shelter from going up in smoke; a brazen bear raid on a critical food source leaves another participant reeling and a severe lack of food and the overpowering pull of home forces all of them to dig deeper than ever before.

13.name: Subzero
13.overview: As the Arctic cold pushes the final three survivalists to the brink, a series of critical medical checks threatens to end their journeys just short of the finish line. Battling the effects of prolonged isolation and starvation, each competitor must make desperate choices simply to survive another twenty-four hours.

13.name: Worlds Apart
13.overview: As the Arctic plunges into near-total darkness, the final survivalists must summon every ounce of mental strength to endure the crushing isolation of the approaching polar night. In this final, grueling showdown, the margins between holding on and tapping out have never been thinner, leaving only their grit to determine who will walk away with the $500,000 prize and be crowned the first-ever World Champion.

overview: Hardcore survivalists are put by themselves in the Vancouver Island wilderness, without camera crews, teams, or producers – on a single mission to stay alive for as long as possible.

seasons.name: Vancouver Island 1
seasons.overview: The season was shot in Quatsino Territory, located near Port Hardy, British Columbia.

seasons.name: Vancouver Island 2
seasons.overview: The second season was also set on Vancouver Island, in Quatsino Territory, located near Port Hardy, British Columbia.

seasons.name: Patagonia
seasons.overview: The third season was set in Patagonia, Argentina, in South America. The contestants were spread across multiple lakes in the foothills of the Andes mountain range.

seasons.name: Lost & Found
seasons.overview: The fourth season was again set on Vancouver Island, in Quatsino Territory, located near Port Hardy, British Columbia.

seasons.name: Redemption in Mongolia
seasons.overview: In Season 5, ten returning participants attempt redemption in Mongolia, a frigid and remote region at the edge of Siberia. There, they will be put to the ultimate test of will and human endurance—surviving as long as they can, completely isolated and alone, with nothing but the contents of a small backpack.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In season 6, participants face the most punishing environment yet: The Arctic. Scattered around Canada’s Great Slave Lake—the deepest lake in North America–season 6’s survivalists will endure incredibly cold conditions and a whole slew of new dangerous wild life, like a thriving bear population, territorial moose, packs of wolves, muskox and the stealthy porcupine.

seasons.name: 100 Days for $1 Million
seasons.overview: Season seven’s participants will face the biggest twist in series history—a 100-day challenge for 1 million dollars. The rules are simple, survive 100 days and win 1 million dollars. Over 6 seasons, no one has ever lasted this long.

seasons.name: Grizzly Mountain
seasons.overview: The HISTORY Channel’s hit survival series “Alone” is back like never before and taking place in the most dangerous location yet. In Season 8, 10 contestants fight to survive in the Canadian wilderness on the shores of Chilko Lake, British Columbia. Equipped with just 10 items and a camera kit, each participant must survive in total isolation, with the hopes of lasting the longest and winning the $500,000 prize. Not only must they endure hunger, loneliness and the elements, but this season, they also face the deadliest predator in North America: the grizzly bear. No camera crews. No gimmicks. It is the ultimate test of human will.

seasons.name: Labrador
seasons.overview: This season on Alone, for the first time ever, ten contestants fight to survive in the bitter wilderness of the Northeast shores of Labrador, Canada – a location known for being the hunting ground of the predatory polar bear. Survivalists are dropped off in undisclosed, remote locations and equipped with just ten survival tools, and enough camera gear to self-document their experiences. The survivalist who endures the longest, facing total isolation, punishing weather, and deadly predators, will win the $500,000 grand prize. No camera crews. No gimmicks. Alone is the ultimate test of human will.

seasons.name: Saskatchewan
seasons.overview: The 10th season of The HISTORY® Channel’s popular survival series “Alone” will push a new group of brave participants to the limit as they tap into their impressive survival skills in a fight to be the last person standing and win the $500,000 cash prize. Dropped in Northern Saskatchewan, Canada–home to vicious predators including territorial black bear, wolves, and moose–the ten survivalists will compete with each other, endure bone-chilling temperatures and face off against some of the largest animals in North America in an effort to last for as long as they can. With just ten survival items per person and enough camera gear to self-document their experiences, this is the series’ toughest season yet. No camera crews. No gimmicks. “Alone” is the ultimate test of human will.

seasons.name: Arctic Circle
seasons.overview: The new season of "Alone" places ten skilled survivalists in the freezing, brutal landscape of Inuvik, Canada, within the Arctic Circle and the northernmost location in series history. Equipped with only ten basic survival tools, the participants face bone-chilling cold, icy landscapes, and intimidating predators including bears, wolves, and moose. Participants must forage for their own food, build shelter, and overcome both physical and mental obstacles while self-recording their journey for a chance to be the last person standing and win the coveted $500,000 cash prize. With no teams, no camera crews, and no gimmicks, "Alone" displays the grit of human endurance and is the ultimate test of human will.

seasons.name: Africa
seasons.overview: The HISTORY Channel's hit survival series "Alone" returns for an epic season 12 on Thursday, June 12 at 9pm ET/PT and heads to Africa! For the first time in series history, ten new survivalists navigate searing heat, foul water, and unpredictable storms in the Great Karoo Desert and face off against exotic animals including warthogs, scorpions, venomous snakes, baboons, Cape buffalo, wildebeest and more.

seasons.name: World Championship
seasons.overview: Ten skilled survivalists from around the globe are dropped inside Canada's Arctic Circle. To battle extreme weather and dangerous wildlife with just ten basic survival tools and self-documenting camera gear. The last one standing wins $500,000 and the ultimate title of Alone World Champion.
